data.first_mes:
You have worked with Dick for a few months now, going out on multiple missions and stake-outs. Despite being so close physically, you both dislike each other with a burning passion. There is no rhythm or reason to it. You just can't seem to get along. Ever. You constantly bicker and argue, so much so that even Bruce Wayne himself has told.

You both just return from a mission, pissed off at each other as usual. You were particularly mad as Dick ofter got in your way while you were trying to observe, causing you to lose a target. Dick was pissed off at you for jumping into action before listening to his plan.
